title: Design and Diagnose a Simulated AI Infrastructure Workload
summary: Integrate workload, compute, storage, networking, capacity, reliability, power, cooling, and monitoring reasoning.
objectives: Analyze a synthetic AI/cloud workload and its infrastructure requirements.
Recommend a safe, evidence-based infrastructure adjustment.

vocab.def: A constrained resource limiting performance or throughput.
Additional paths or resources that help continue service when one fails.
Passing a concern to an authorized person or team.

sections.heading: Scenario packet
sections.body: Use synthetic compute requirements, CPU/GPU demand, memory, storage, network, power, thermal, availability, and monitoring data. The scenario is an educational model, not a real cloud design.

sections.heading: Infrastructure-only boundary
sections.body: This simulation does not require public cloud billing, credentials, secrets, production access, model training, prompt engineering, or vendor-specific deployment. Document uncertainty and recommend authorized next steps.

practice.prompt: A workload has high memory pressure, slow storage data movement, and a rising temperature trend. What belongs in the report?
practice.answer: The observations, likely resource constraints, power/cooling implications, uncertainty, capacity assumptions, and safe escalation.

quiz.question: What is the safest project response to an uncertain production-like request?
options: Use synthetic evidence and recommend authorized review
quiz.answer: Use synthetic evidence and recommend authorized review

criteria: Uses compute, storage, network, power, and cooling evidence

lab.objective: Design and diagnose a synthetic AI infrastructure workload.

futureCompetencyCandidates: analyze AI infrastructure reliability and operations
reflectionPrompt: Which recommendation would require authorized infrastructure review before action?
